Class GraphGrokDoor

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.GraphGrokDoor
All Implemented Interfaces:
GraphDoor
public final class GraphGrokDoor extends Object implements GraphDoor
The door sends one intent brief through the Grok chat the shell already uses. The key is not written to a log.

  • Constructor Details

    • GraphGrokDoor

      public GraphGrokDoor(String engine)
      The constructor keeps the model id. A Grok engine uses the id after the slash. Any other engine uses FRONTIER. The call stays unstreamed.
      Parameters:
      engine - The engine is the card's execution target. The value may be empty.

    • GraphGrokDoor

      GraphGrokDoor(String engine, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink, Runnable end)
      The constructor keeps the model id and a thought ear. A null ear leaves the call unstreamed. Kind t is forwarded. Any other kind is dropped. end runs when the ask returns, including when the call throws.
      Parameters:
      engine - The engine is the card's execution target. The value may be empty.
      sink - The sink hears a reasoning chunk. The value may be null.
      end - The end closes the thinking block. The value may be null.

    • GraphGrokDoor

      GraphGrokDoor(String engine, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink, Runnable end, GrokCallOptions seated)
      The constructor keeps the model id, a thought ear, and the stored options. A null options value uses callOptions(boolean) for the ear.
      Parameters:
      engine - The engine is the card's execution target. The value may be empty.
      sink - The sink hears a reasoning chunk. The value may be null.
      end - The end closes the thinking block. The value may be null.
      seated - The options are the stored model options. The value may be null.

  • Method Details

    • ask

      public String ask(String brief) throws Exception
      The method sends the brief and returns the assistant text. A missing key throws GrokLlmService.KeyMissingException.
      Specified by:
      ask in interface GraphDoor
      Parameters:
      brief - The brief is the intent ask.
      Returns:
      The return value is the assistant text.
      Throws:
      Exception - The exception is a door that does not send.

    • seatedOptions

      GrokCallOptions seatedOptions()
      The method returns the options this door will send. A stored seat wins. A missing seat uses callOptions(boolean) for the ear.
      Returns:
      The return value is the call options.

    • callOptions

      static GrokCallOptions callOptions(boolean thinking)

    • forward

      private GrokLlmService.DeltaSink forward()
      The method forwards kind t when a thought ear is present. A quiet door returns null, so the call stays unstreamed.
      Returns:
      The return value is the forwarding sink, or null.

    • systemText

      static String systemText()
      The method teaches the block. The shape names are not aims. An aim is a thing the window holds. The pool door sends this same text.
      Returns:
      The return value is the system text.
